topic: Life Cycles of Animals and Humans
key_concepts: Butterflies have four life cycle stages
Frogs have four life cycle stages
Chickens have four life cycle stages
Humans have six life cycle stages: fetus, baby, childhood, adolescence, adulthood, old per
Physical features change across human life stages
Human growth involves emotional, social, and mental changes
Chickens benefit humans in agriculture and food production
Complete metamorphosis differs from incomplete metamorphosis
Grasshoppers have a life cycle that can be compared with butterflies
Fish life cycles can be compared with frog life cycles
